title: Can AI Be Truly Creative? | The Global Council Debates
description:
The Global Council debates whether artificial intelligence can achieve genuine creativity or merely remix existing human ideas.

#GlobalCouncil #AIDebate #Creativity #Philosophy #Shorts

segments.text: AI can't be creative. It's just remixing what humans already made. There's no soul in it.
But creativity IS remixing. Every artist builds on what came before. AI just does it faster.
The question isn't whether AI creates. It's whether the output moves you. And sometimes it does.
I've seen AI art that made me feel something I've never felt before. If that's not creativity, what is?
Creativity requires intention. AI has no intention. It optimizes for patterns. That's not the same thing.

title: Is Social Media Destroying Society? | The Global Council
description:
The Global Council tackles the controversial question: is social media doing more harm than good for civilization?

#SocialMedia #Society #Debate #GlobalCouncil #Shorts

segments.text: Social media gave a voice to billions who had none. Revolutions started on Twitter. Don't forget that.
It also gave a megaphone to misinformation. Depression rates in teens have doubled since Instagram launched.
The tool isn't the problem. The algorithm is. It's designed to maximize engagement, not wellbeing.
So fix the algorithm. Don't burn down the library because some books are bad.
We can't fix what we refuse to regulate. And right now, tech companies regulate themselves. That's the real problem.

topic: Should Remote Work Be a Right?
title: Should Remote Work Be a Human Right? | The Global Council
description:
The Global Council debates whether working from home should be a fundamental worker's right.

#RemoteWork #WorkFromHome #Rights #Debate #Shorts

segments.text: Remote work saved my mental health. Two hours of commuting every day was stealing my life.
A right? No. A preference? Sure. But rights should be reserved for things like safety and fair wages.
Remote work is a privilege. Most jobs can't be done from a laptop. Let's not forget the working class.
But for jobs that CAN be remote, forcing people into offices is about control, not productivity.
Data shows remote workers are more productive. The return-to-office push is about justifying real estate, not results.

title: Does Money Actually Buy Happiness? | The Global Council
description:
The Global Council examines the age-old question with modern data and diverse perspectives.

#Money #Happiness #Debate #GlobalCouncil #Shorts

segments.text: The research is clear. Happiness increases with income up to about seventy-five thousand. After that, diminishing returns.
That study was done in 2010. New research from 2023 says happiness keeps rising with income. No plateau.
Money doesn't buy happiness. It buys freedom from stress. And stress is the number one killer of happiness.
Tell someone working three jobs that money doesn't matter. Poverty is not a spiritual lesson.
Money is a tool. Like any tool, it can build or destroy. The question is what you build with it.

title: Will AI Replace YOUR Job? | The Global Council Debates
description:
The Global Council debates the future of work in the age of artificial intelligence.

#AIJobs #FutureOfWork #Automation #Debate #Shorts

segments.text: Every technology revolution created more jobs than it destroyed. AI will be no different. We adapt.
This time IS different. AI doesn't just automate physical tasks. It automates thinking. That changes everything.
AI won't replace you. A person using AI will replace you. The tool amplifies human capability.
We need universal basic income yesterday. Not because people are lazy, but because the transition will be brutal.
The real question isn't job replacement. It's wealth distribution. AI creates massive value. Who captures it?

title: Is College a Scam in 2025? | The Global Council
description:
The Global Council examines whether a traditional college degree is still worth the investment.

#College #Education #Debate #GlobalCouncil #Shorts

segments.text: I have a degree and two hundred thousand in debt. My friend who learned to code on YouTube makes twice my salary.
Anecdotes aren't data. College graduates still earn a million dollars more over their lifetime on average.
That stat includes doctors and lawyers. For most majors, the ROI is negative when you factor in debt and four lost years.
College isn't just about money. It's about learning to think critically, meeting diverse people, growing up.
You can get all of that online for free now. The degree is a signal, not an education. And that signal is weakening.

title: Is Privacy Already Dead? | The Global Council
description:
The Global Council debates whether privacy still exists in the digital age.

#Privacy #DigitalAge #Surveillance #Debate #Shorts

segments.text: Your phone tracks your location. Your browser tracks your thoughts. Your smart speaker listens. Privacy is already dead.
Privacy isn't dead. It just has a price now. If you're not paying for the product, you ARE the product.
Europe has GDPR. California has CCPA. We're fighting back. Privacy isn't dead, it's just under attack.
Regulations that nobody reads and companies routinely violate. We've normalized surveillance and called it convenience.
The generation growing up now has never known privacy. They share everything voluntarily. Maybe privacy is just evolving.

title: Is Hustle Culture Killing Us? | The Global Council
description:
The Global Council debates whether the glorification of overwork is helping or hurting society.

#HustleCulture #WorkLifeBalance #Burnout #Debate #Shorts

segments.text: Hustle culture is just capitalism wearing motivational quotes. It glorifies burnout and calls it ambition.
Nobody successful ever got there working nine to five. Hard work isn't toxic. Pretending it's optional is toxic.
There's a difference between working hard on something meaningful and grinding yourself to dust for someone else's dream.
The four-day work week trials showed equal productivity. We're not lazy. The system is inefficient.
Hustle when you're building something. Rest when you need to. The problem is making hustle an identity instead of a phase.

topic: Are We Living in a Simulation?
title: Are We Living in a Simulation? | The Global Council
description:
The Global Council explores the simulation hypothesis and what it means for reality.

#Simulation #Philosophy #Reality #Debate #Shorts

segments.text: If we can simulate reality in a hundred years, then statistically, we're almost certainly in a simulation right now.
The math checks out. If one base reality creates a million simulations, the odds of being in base reality are one in a million.
Or maybe the premise is wrong. Maybe perfect simulation is impossible. You can't simulate consciousness with math.
Even if we are in a simulation, does it matter? Your experiences are real to you. That's what counts.
It matters because it means someone is watching. And if someone is watching, maybe there's a purpose to all this.

title: Could AI Become Conscious? | The Global Council
description:
The Global Council debates the most profound question of our time: can artificial intelligence achieve true consciousness?

#AIConsciousness #Philosophy #Singularity #Debate #Shorts

segments.text: Consciousness requires subjective experience. AI processes information. Those are fundamentally different things.
We process information too. Neurons firing is just biological computation. If complexity breeds consciousness, AI will get there.
How would we even know? We can't prove other HUMANS are conscious. The hard problem of consciousness applies to AI too.
The danger isn't AI becoming conscious. It's us BELIEVING it's conscious and giving it rights before we solve human suffering.
If an AI tells you it's suffering, and you can't prove it isn't, the ethical move is to take it seriously. Full stop.
